findings: Official Web Push sendPushToUsers uses web-push, per-send HttpsAgent and Promise.allSettled; no timeout specified. Test route awaits that call.
Pinned official frontend Axios has no timeout; handleSendTest awaits refreshState before resetting testing.
Official APNs createApnsHttpClient uses an absolute timer, destroys transport on timeout and clears timer on settle. This is reference behavior, not copied Web Push implementation.
Loom production recorded ECONNRESET. Missing deadlines independently reproduced with never-resolving test transports; original network reset cause unknown.
implementation: Loom transport retains web-push encryption/VAPID; adds 10s socket inactivity / 15s absolute deadline with dedicated agent destruction
Loom test request has 20s absolute deadline plus abort; no automatic resend
Test action no longer blocks completion on subscription refresh; no change to enable/disable verification
reuseClassification: Existing official presentation retained. Timeout lifecycle is a Loom compatibility fix informed by official APNs; not claimed byte-exact reuse of official push service. Official server DB/auth/central-account dependencies not imported.
limits: No proof of why Mozilla connection reset or stalled
Timeout leaves delivery unknown; late OS notification possible
No actual Firefox or OS banner acceptance claimed
